messy: I need a simple internal tracker so two recruiters can log candidates, move them through stages, and I can see who is stuck. No public careers site.

structured.primary_outcome: every candidate has a visible stage and stuck candidates are obvious
structured.business_outcome: founder can see who is stuck without asking
structured.success_criteria: a recruiter can create a candidate, set a stage, list all candidates, and filter stuck ones
structured.constraints: no public careers site, one company, no applicant login
structured.priorities: stage visibility first, then stuck filter
